sloka: ऋक्ष वानर गोपुच्छाः क्षिप्रम् एव अभिजज्ञिरे ।यस्य देवस्य यद् रूपम् वेषो यः च पराक्रमः ॥१-१७-१९॥
transliteration: ṛkṣa vānara gopucchāḥ kṣipram eva abhijajñire ।yasya devasya yad rūpam veṣo yaḥ ca parākramaḥ ॥1-17-19॥

translations.english: Some monkeys with acknowledged, valour were born to female monkeys with tails Similarly some other monkeys were born to female bears and female kinnaras.
